label: Notchy, imprecise manual gearbox shifting
symptom: The manual gearbox has a notchy, baggy, and imprecise shifting feel, which is noticeable during gear changes.
warning_signs: ["Notchy gear engagement", "Vague or baggy shift feel"]
inspection_advice: Test drive and pay close attention to the feel of the manual gearshift.

label: 1.0 TCE sluggish at low RPM with turbo lag
symptom: Engine feels sluggish at low revs with poor in-gear acceleration; meaningful power arrives only near 3000 RPM due to turbo lag.
warning_signs: ["Sluggish acceleration from low RPM", "Delayed power delivery"]
inspection_advice: Test drive from low RPM to assess turbo response and in-gear acceleration.
